# MLB Auctions

> > Official auction platform for authenticated Major League Baseball memorabilia, game-used equipment, and autographed collectibles.

MLB Auctions offers fans and collectors the opportunity to bid on authentic baseball memorabilia directly from MLB, featuring items from players like Aaron Judge, Ronald Acuna Jr., Paul Skenes, and Francisco Lindor, as well as special events like the World Baseball Classic. All items are authenticated through MLB Authentication to ensure legitimacy.
